_comment: Triage suitability, scored on verdict only. Accept labels apps-1665..apps-2725 are based on earlier local sim:nsh checks; apps-1857 was validated with scripts/validate_instance.py (fails before, passes after). Validation traces are not included here. Issue and feature policy remain open.

Rejects are metadata/diff judgments in docs/nuttx_bad_prs.md. apps-2137 comes from a validator run: the fixed kernel does not link on sim:nsh. Validator runs of apps-1792 and apps-3401 ended ambiguous because the changed test never ran under sim:nsh; that is consistent with rejection but is not a failure trace. Labels may be revisited with new evidence.

reject.apps-1792: Paired Kconfig guard update, without a new regression assertion
reject.apps-2137: Kernel adds the SMP call backend for arm64 only; the fixed kernel cannot link on sim:nsh
reject.apps-3401: Fix is in the apps test source, not the kernel
reject.apps-3676: Disables the failing test on the affected target
reject.apps-3767: Test stack maintenance without a kernel fix
reject.apps-3785: Sensor test can skip; no deterministic failure shown
reject.kernel-20091: Kernel fix without an identified changed apps regression test
